prelude:
import { email, attio } from adapters
import { inbox_cred, crm_cred } from credentials
inbox = connect email using inbox_cred
crm = connect attio using crm_cred

patterns.name: expression:llm
patterns.note: AI() asks llm.client.call at its tier

patterns.name: extract_tier
patterns.note: an extraction call's tier, read from the deployment's tier table (a run input)

patterns.name: meta:user_email
patterns.note: @user_* asks lookup.resolveActingUser once per segment, a malformed answer included

patterns.name: meta:user_id
patterns.note: @user_id, as meta:user_email

patterns.name: meta:actor_email
patterns.note: @actor_* asks the source adapter's extractActor once per segment

patterns.name: function:domain_of
patterns.note: a function a write field advertises runs through invokeFieldFunction; inside a `unique by` write it is refused as unsupported (a gap reachability lists)

patterns.name: function:file
patterns.note: FILE() asks files.render

patterns.name: function:read
patterns.note: READ() asks files.resolveFileText, an unreadable answer included

patterns.name: expression_does_not_lower
patterns.note: an expression the checker cannot read (MOV_EXPR_PARSE) ends at the check; a held list of a block's records read back runs whole

patterns.name: extract_proto_field
patterns.note: a field and a node of an extraction's shape named __proto__: from version 5 an ordinary name, read off the answer as its own key

patterns.name: language_version_unsupported
patterns.note: a pin this release does not run ends at the check (MOVENG_LANGUAGE_VERSION)

patterns.name: import_from_file
patterns.note: a library file's functions run in the library's own scope, its shapes and types read where written; a file the snapshot does not carry ends at the check (MOV_IMPORT_FILE_UNSUPPORTED)

patterns.name: file_assignment
patterns.note: a file-level extraction or node: from version 5 a file-level value holds a value only (MOV_FILE_VALUE_RUNS)

patterns.name: file_call
patterns.note: a file-level plugin call: refused as file_assignment is (MOV_FILE_VALUE_RUNS)

patterns.name: file_statement:<kind>
patterns.note: a statement at file scope (a write, an if) runs nothing

patterns.name: movement_value_param@entry
patterns.note: a function taking a value, fired itself, fails the run before its body

patterns.name: movement_value_param
patterns.note: a function taking a value that no call reaches: walked as a closure, or never run

patterns.name: name_shadowed
patterns.note: a body binding a name its parameters or the file bind: the checker refuses it (MOV_SHADOWED_NAME, MOV_REBOUND_NAME)

patterns.name: name_rebound
patterns.note: one name bound twice where one binding sees the other: the checker refuses it (MOV_REBOUND_NAME, MOV_SHADOWED_NAME)

patterns.name: name_not_value
patterns.note: a plugin argument naming a record bare (a handle, an extraction's record, a node) is handed the record's fields

patterns.name: plugin_arg_record
patterns.note: a record inside a list or map handed to a plugin's argument: the checker refuses it (MOV_CALL_ARG_TYPE); a helper function's json parameter under a key runs whole

patterns.name: builtin_arg_record
patterns.note: a record handed to a built-in's text parameter: the checker refuses it (MOV_RECORD_NOT_A_VALUE)

patterns.name: write_field_record
patterns.note: a record reaching a system write's json field: the checker refuses it (MOV_WRITE_FIELD_TYPE, and MOV_CLOSURE_NOT_DATA for closures held in a list); a field read off a closure's record parameter runs whole

patterns.name: call_arg_record
patterns.note: a value that may hold a record handed to a value parameter: the checker refuses it (MOV_CALL_ARG_MAYBE_RECORD)

patterns.name: value_call_arg_record
patterns.note: a call through a value handed an argument that may be a record: the checker refuses it (MOV_CALL_ARG_MAYBE_RECORD)

patterns.name: position_arg_record
patterns.note: a graph entry that may hold a record, handed to a record parameter: the checker refuses it (MOV_GRAPH_ENTRY_RECORD); a clean graph runs whole

patterns.name: extract_from_record
patterns.note: an extraction call over a record, a map or a list holding one: the checker holds the content to text and files (MOV_EXTRACT_CONTENT)

patterns.name: at_record_key
patterns.note: AT on a record with a key that is not an index: the checker refuses it (MOV_AT_RECORD_KEY)

patterns.name: node_spread_record
patterns.note: a map holding a record spread into a graph: the checker refuses it (MOV_GRAPH_SPREAD_RECORD); a clean map runs whole

patterns.name: statement:call
patterns.note: a call statement of a closure bound to a name (recursion, a park inside it); a match statement gating nothing and a built-in's value dropped end at the check

patterns.name: movement_call
patterns.note: a function called by name, its returned value the call's

patterns.name: function_call
patterns.note: a closure called by name, one returned by a call, and from version 5 one called through a value; a list of closures ends at the check (MOV_CLOSURE_NOT_DATA)

patterns.name: rvalue:closure
patterns.note: a closure written where a value goes: from version 5 a closure is a value and a function's argument, never data (MOV_CLOSURE_NOT_DATA)

patterns.name: rvalue:lazy
patterns.note: a kept (lazy) walk returned from a function's body runs whole; counted as a bare value it is refused as unsupported (a gap reachability lists)

patterns.name: rvalue:inlineBlock
patterns.note: the retired inline block (`{ … }.name`): the checker refuses it (MOV_INLINE_BLOCK_RETIRED)

patterns.name: expression_closure
patterns.note: a collection call written inside an expression, staged at its place; a closure where nothing stages one ends at the check

patterns.name: statement:collection
patterns.note: a collection call's members run `concurrency` at a time, each in a flow of its own, their traces in member order

patterns.name: rvalue:collection
patterns.note: as statement:collection, bound (REDUCE carries what the members before each answered)

patterns.name: statement:refresh
patterns.note: refresh re-fetches the handle's record, and every holder of it moves on in place

patterns.name: statement:<kind>
patterns.note: a shape declared in a body is hoisted for the body; any other statement kind there the parser or the checker refuses

patterns.name: rvalue:extractCall
patterns.note: `extract(…)` and `extractOne(…)`: the prompt laid out for the cache, llm.extractCall.call at the call's settings, one retry, files read once per run

patterns.name: extract_call_shape
patterns.note: a shape written in place reads its words in the body's scope; a name bound to a shape is the shape

patterns.name: extract_call_settings
patterns.note: an extraction call's settings that do not read clean: the checker refuses them (MOV_EXTRACT_CONFIG)

patterns.name: extract_call_model
patterns.note: an extraction call's written model, held to the catalog snapshot's models (the oracle's snapshot has none, so it is unchecked)

patterns.name: rvalue:<kind>
patterns.note: a `return` of a write or of a block (its iterations returning, a park inside joined by its fan-out)

patterns.name: plugin_call
patterns.note: a plugin's call as imported; one spelled in another letter case ends at the check from version 5 (MOV_NAME_UNRESOLVED, MOV_FUNCTION_UNKNOWN)

patterns.name: plugin_call:records
patterns.note: a records output binds one record per record found, in order, the empty list for none (malformed answers included)

patterns.name: plugin_call_form
patterns.note: a plugin's arguments: a built-in's call, a node as its fields, a function's value, positional from version 5; a write as an argument ends at the check (MOV_CALL_ARG_TYPE)

patterns.name: builtin_call_form
patterns.note: a call among a built-in's arguments, staged at its place

patterns.name: match_tuple
patterns.note: a match at the convergence of a tuple of paths, bound or missed as a linked match is

patterns.name: match_position
patterns.note: a match of a bare alias: the parser refuses it

patterns.name: write_position_not_record
patterns.note: `write x { … }` where x is a node: the checker refuses it (MOV_WRITE_POSITION_NOT_RECORD); what a node's edge holds runs whole

patterns.name: delete_not_record
patterns.note: a delete of what its system does not declare deletable, or of no record: the checker refuses it (MOV_DELETE_NOT_DECLARED, MOV_DELETE_NOT_RECORD)

patterns.name: write_position_member_path
patterns.note: `write m.k { … }` updates the record the member holds

patterns.name: write_root_expression
patterns.note: a linked write rooted at an expression that is no member path: the parser refuses it; one rooted at a map member's record runs whole

patterns.name: match_root_expression
patterns.note: a linked match rooted as write_root_expression is

patterns.name: write_root_not_held
patterns.note: a linked write rooted at a declared shape writes an in-memory position of the shape's type; with a `unique by` it is refused as unsupported (a gap reachability lists)

patterns.name: match_root_not_held
patterns.note: a linked match rooted at a declared shape: the checker refuses it (MOV_LINKED_UNKNOWN_EDGE)

patterns.name: write_multi_hop
patterns.note: a linked write walking more than one edge: refused as unsupported after the writes before it (a gap reachability lists)

patterns.name: match_multi_hop
patterns.note: a linked match walking more than one edge: as write_multi_hop

patterns.name: write_spread_path
patterns.note: `...m.k` in a write: a node the program spells out, held under a key, runs whole; one it does not spell out the checker refuses (MOV_WRITE_SPREAD_SOURCE)

patterns.name: node_spread
patterns.note: a spread in a `node { … }` literal: the parser refuses it

patterns.name: node_spread_path
patterns.note: a spread of a map's or a record's member into a graph, what the member holds copied

patterns.name: node_spread_source
patterns.note: a spread of the event, or of a block's landing, into a graph

patterns.name: unique_by_without_key
patterns.note: a `unique by` with no key: the checker refuses it (MOV_UNIQUE_CONJUNCT_NEEDS_WHERE)

patterns.name: unique_by_reads_beyond_candidate
patterns.note: a `unique by` conjunct reading beyond the candidate: the checker refuses it (MOV_UNIQUE_CONJUNCT_NEEDS_WHERE)

patterns.name: node_declared_entry
patterns.note: a declared edge entry inside a graph literal: the parser refuses it

patterns.name: node_event_entry
patterns.note: a graph entry holding the event holds it as its record, across a park too; a node literal's entry holding it the checker refuses (MOV_NODE_ENTRY_NODE_VALUE)

patterns.name: rvalue:node
patterns.note: a node a block's iteration returns

patterns.name: exists_node
patterns.note: EXISTS off a run-built node, over more than one hop or with an ORDER BY

patterns.name: is_test_declared_record
patterns.note: an `IS <Decl>` test of a system's record, decided by a check.compatible request

patterns.name: is_test_declared_graph
patterns.note: an `IS <Decl>` test of a graph literal's edge, compared with the declaration's node there

patterns.name: block_head_expression_root
patterns.note: a block head rooted at a list's member: the member may be absent, which the checker refuses unguarded (MOV_ABSENT_REQUIRED)

patterns.name: block_head_value_root
patterns.note: a block head rooted at a kept walk continues it past its head; one off a value holding records walks them

patterns.name: block_multi_hop
patterns.note: a block head walks every hop off every path the hop before reached, each alias naming its level's record

patterns.name: block_head_extract_hop
patterns.note: a block head over an extraction's records, walking the one record an extractOne hands back

patterns.name: block_head_resources
patterns.note: a `_resources` head off an extraction call's result: the checker refuses it (MOV_RESOURCES_NOT_EXTRACTED), though version 5 reads `_resources` only off an extraction's result

patterns.name: select_multi_hop
patterns.note: a pick walks every hop as a block head does

patterns.name: traversal_step
patterns.note: a walk with a `#transform` hop: the checker refuses the retired hop (MOV_TRANSFORM_HOP_RETIRED)

patterns.name: exists_step
patterns.note: an EXISTS hop that is not an edge: as traversal_step

patterns.name: walk_extract_hop
patterns.note: a hop down the record an extractOne hands back, with a WHERE, ORDER BY or LIMIT

patterns.name: exists_extract_hop
patterns.note: EXISTS down the record an extractOne hands back, reading each hop's WHERE, ORDER BY and LIMIT

patterns.name: aggregate:llm
patterns.note: the `LLM_AGG` fold: the checker refuses it (MOV_BUILTIN_NOT_RUN)

patterns.name: aggregate:only
patterns.note: ONLY of any expression, its failure spelling the expression back; a node entry holding it, and a resource walk, end at the check

patterns.name: aggregate:sort_key
patterns.note: `sort(xs, key)` with a function key over records and maps; `SORT` with a key that is no function ends at the check (MOV_V5_SPELLING)

patterns.name: aggregate_records
patterns.note: a fold of a bare walk inside a list or map

patterns.name: expression:<type>
patterns.note: the retired KG_VALUE and KG_EXISTS pass the checker and are refused as unsupported (a gap reachability lists); `_resources`, @resource and @parent reads end at the check

patterns.name: expression:exists
patterns.note: a rootless `EXISTS(-[…]->)` outside a WHERE is refused as unsupported (a gap reachability lists); inside a hop's WHERE it walks off the landed record

patterns.name: meta:<key>
patterns.note: an unknown `@` key (`@trigger`, `@mutationContext`): the checker refuses it (MOV_META_UNKNOWN_KEY)

patterns.name: function:<id>
patterns.note: a built-in function by name (CHUNKS among them); a closure called in another letter case ends at the check from version 5 (MOV_FUNCTION_UNKNOWN)

patterns.name: nested_call
patterns.note: a closure's, a plugin's or an extraction's call inside an expression, staged in the order written and only where reached (AND, OR, IF and COALESCE skip what they do not need); one that would park the checker refuses (MOV_NESTED_CALL_SUSPENDS)

patterns.name: nested_call_form
patterns.note: a nested call handed a write, a node, a function or a type

patterns.name: nested_movement_call
patterns.note: a function called inside an expression, staged as the binding it means

patterns.name: within_compare
patterns.note: `WITHIN`, measured from the host's clock, in an expression and in a hop's WHERE

patterns.name: static_number
patterns.note: a `-0` literal is `0`, a -0 computed at run time is -0, across a park too; `1e400` does not parse (MOV_EXPR_PARSE)

patterns.name: proto_key
patterns.note: a `__proto__` key written in a map literal

patterns.name: import_from_<namespace>
patterns.note: an import from a namespace other than adapters, credentials and plugins: the parser refuses it

patterns.name: block_head_rootless
patterns.note: a block head with no root passes the checker and is refused as unsupported, after the writes before it (a gap reachability lists)

patterns.name: block_head_root
patterns.note: a block head rooted at a name no record is held under: the checker refuses it (MOV_HEAD_NOT_A_POSITION, MOV_TRAVERSE_UNKNOWN_EDGE)

patterns.name: block_head_step
patterns.note: a block head with a `#transform` hop: the checker refuses the retired hop (MOV_TRANSFORM_HOP_RETIRED)

patterns.name: traversal_root
patterns.note: a hop off a kept walk continues it past its head

patterns.name: traversal_steps
patterns.note: a field read off a held name that also walks hops

patterns.name: traversal_terminal
patterns.note: a walk ending in anything but a field

patterns.name: resume_state_does_not_read
patterns.note: a parked state whose journal or scopes do not read: the resume refuses it (resume_state_does_not_read); the state as parked resumes whole

patterns.name: resume_state_code_does_not_read
patterns.note: a parked state naming code (a closure, a kept walk's head) the pinned program does not hold: the resume fails at run time where the code is read (MOVENG_RUNTIME), not up front by this name

patterns.name: resume_state_version
patterns.note: a parked state of another park-state version than this engine writes (2): a version 1 state is the TypeScript engine's, and the resume refuses it (resume_state_version)

patterns.name: resume_state_suspended
patterns.note: a parked state whose `suspended` is not true: the resume refuses it (resume_state_suspended)

patterns.name: resume_state_kind:localShape
patterns.note: a shape declared in a body, held across a park, rebuilt from its declaration

patterns.name: resume_state_kind:blockMeta
patterns.note: a parked state holding a block's meta edges bound as a name, which no run makes: the resume refuses it (resume_state_kind:blockMeta)

patterns.name: event_does_not_cross
patterns.note: an event the eval wire cannot carry as itself (a Map): the shim refuses it before the engine opens (event_does_not_cross)

patterns.name: event_field_dated
patterns.note: a date-typed event field, its ISO text

patterns.name: condition_does_not_lower
patterns.note: a field read off a call's answer in a condition

patterns.name: statement:combinator
patterns.note: `all` and `race` as statements, their functions as arguments; `parallel` and a list of arms end at the check (MOV_PARALLEL_RETIRED, MOV_COMBINATOR_ARMS_ARE_ARGUMENTS)

patterns.name: rvalue:combinator
patterns.note: `all` and `race` bound, their settings (`concurrency`, `onError`) included; `parallel` and a list of arms end at the check, as statement:combinator

patterns.name: write_tuple
patterns.note: a write at the convergence of a tuple of paths

patterns.name: write_node_root
patterns.note: writes into a node the run built

patterns.name: graph_shape
patterns.note: a shaped graph literal

patterns.name: node_traversal_entry
patterns.note: a graph entry holding a traversal

patterns.name: block_head_node_root
patterns.note: a block head over a node the run built

patterns.name: walk_records
patterns.note: a bare walk read as its records

patterns.name: rvalue:members
patterns.note: MEMBERS of a declared type

patterns.name: lazy_park
patterns.note: a kept walk held across a park, then counted: refused as unsupported (a gap reachability lists)

patterns.name: resume_state_kind:closure
patterns.note: a closure held across a park, and resumed

patterns.name: resume_state_extraction_origin
patterns.note: an extraction's values held across a park, and resumed

patterns.name: name_not_value@plugin
patterns.note: a plugin's call handed a handle (the record read as its fields); the event, whose `deck` field is a file, ends at the check (MOV_CALL_ARG_TYPE)
